Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3EE743FE...@white-wolf.com>, LSJ <vtesrep@white-

wolf.com> writes:
>XZealot wrote:
>> Actually, I meant Computer Hacking instead of Skullduggery. Can anyone tell
>> me why Skull duggery would ever be better than Computer Hacking?
>
>Stealth. Maneuver.

Flexibility. A Setite-Anarch deck gets the benefit of obf/pre, which
lets it choose whether it wants extra bleed or extra stealth.

A Gangrel deck, which starts finding the blood lost to Earth Control and
Rapid Change a little too taxing, might find a free +1 stealth on bleeds
useful - which is effectively what it amounts to, though you can't play
it on top of Computer Hacking, of course.
